sections.heading: Output (Print Text)
sections.body: To output values or print text in C, you can use the printf() function:

sections.heading: Double Quotes
sections.body:
When you want to print text, the text must be wrapped in double quotes "".

If you forget the double quotes, an error occurs:

Tip: If you see strange error messages, check that your text starts and ends with double quotes.
sections.code:
printf("This sentence will work!");

  printf(This sentence will produce an error.);

sections.heading: Many printf() Functions
sections.body:
You can use as many printf() functions as you want.

However, note that it does not insert a new line at the end of the output:

Notice: All the text appears on the same line. In the next chapter, you will learn how to add new lines to make the output easier to read.
